summary: Verified ATR filtering fix for low-ATR breakout allowance (Mode C from user request). All 21 backend_test.py tests and 173 pytest tests pass. The key test 'test_low_atr_breakout_allowed_but_pullback_blocked' validates: breakout scenarios pass even when ATR < min_atr_pct, while pullback/non-breakout scenarios are rejected as atr_too_low.
passed_tests: Low ATR breakout allowed: breakout signals pass with ATR 0.05% (below 0.25% threshold)
Low ATR pullback blocked: pullback signals rejected as atr_too_low when ATR < 0.25%
ATR check moved to post-signal validation: entry_engine.generate_signal runs first
structure_breakout metadata flag bypasses ATR filter
Non-breakout scenarios still properly filtered by low ATR
critical_code_review_comments: Line 536-537 in main.py correctly implements Mode C: `if atr_pct < self.min_atr_pct and not signal.metadata.get('structure_breakout'): return reject('atr_too_low')`
ATR filter now runs AFTER entry_engine.generate_signal() so breakout detection has occurred
Only signals with structure_breakout=True bypass the ATR filter
Pullback scenarios (structure_pullback=True but structure_breakout=False) are still rejected with low ATR as intended
This addresses user's SCAN SUMMARY showing 'atr_too_low=7' rejections for breakout opportunities
seed_data_creation: None - all tests use synthetic/mocked data
context_for_next_testing_agent: ATR filtering for breakouts verified. The fix moves ATR validation to post-signal phase so breakout structures (structure_breakout=True) pass even with low ATR, while pullback entries remain blocked by low ATR. The test_low_atr_breakout_allowed_but_pullback_blocked test validates both scenarios with ATR=0.05% vs threshold 0.25%.
rca_of_the_issue: User's live logs showed 'atr_too_low=7' rejects during scans. The original code checked ATR BEFORE signal generation, blocking breakout candidates prematurely. Fix: move ATR check to AFTER entry_engine.generate_signal() and add exemption for structure_breakout flag. Now breakout scenarios bypass ATR filter while pullback scenarios are still protected.
